question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the capitalised word in the given sentence.**

We paid her a **FLEETING** visit before leaving the country.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Brief."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Fleeting" **means something that lasts for a very short time or passes quickly, brief. (बहुत कम समय तक चलने वाला)

 
 
• **Example**: *This is just a **fleeting**__ visit.*
 
 
 
• **"Brief" **means short or quick. (संक्षिप्‍त या अल्‍पकालिक)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We had a **brief**__ meeting with the client before finalizing the deal.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of** "fleeting"** is **"brief."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Final)** means something that is ultimate or conclusive. (अंतिम (क्रम की दृष्टि से))
 
• **Option 3 (Hasty)** means something that is done in a hurry or without proper thought. (जल्‍दी में कहा या किया हुआ; तीव्र गतिक)
 
• **Option 4 (Last)** means something that comes at the end or is final in a series. (अंत का, अंतिम; सबके बाद, अंत में)
